verdict.rationale: Plaid documents that Monitor integrates directly with Identity Verification for an 'end-to-end verification and KYC solution' allowing checks for watchlists and PEP lists, and risk results surface in the same Dashboard — satisfying the 'one vendor' aspect. However, this is explicitly a two-product integration (IDV + Monitor) rather than a single unified product/API, and adverse-media screening specifically is not mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit adverse-media watchlist coverage, confirmation of a single unified API call spanning both products, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the combined review surface.
